data.name: Control_Display_Name
data.value: Unified WhatsApp conversation

data.name: Control_Description
data.value: Shows separate Contact Center transcripts as one chronological WhatsApp conversation.

data.name: Anchor_Display_Name
data.value: Anchor

data.name: Anchor_Description
data.value: Text column used to host the control. No value is stored.

data.name: Customer_Display_Name
data.value: Customer

data.name: Customer_Description
data.value: Contact or account whose WhatsApp history is displayed.

data.name: Entity_Id_Display_Name
data.value: Entity ID

data.name: Entity_Id_Description
data.value: Current form record ID, used as the customer ID on Contact forms.

data.name: Entity_Name_Display_Name
data.value: Entity name

data.name: Entity_Name_Description
data.value: Logical name of the current form table.

data.name: History_Months_Display_Name
data.value: History in months

data.name: History_Months_Description
data.value: Number of months to load. Defaults to 12 and is limited to 60.

data.name: Maximum_Conversations_Display_Name
data.value: Maximum conversations

data.name: Maximum_Conversations_Description
data.value: Maximum number of technical conversations to merge. Defaults to 50.

data.name: Page_Size_Display_Name
data.value: Conversations per page

data.name: Page_Size_Description
data.value: Number of conversations loaded at a time. More are loaded when the user scrolls down. Defaults to 3, maximum 20.

data.name: Height_Display_Name
data.value: Height in pixels

data.name: Height_Description
data.value: Fixed height of the control. Leave empty to fit the available space of the form; the conversation scrolls inside the control.

data.name: Sort_Order_Display_Name
data.value: Sort order

data.name: Sort_Order_Description
data.value: Order of conversations and messages. Defaults to newest first.

data.name: Sort_Newest_First_Display_Name
data.value: Newest first

data.name: Sort_Newest_First_Description
data.value: Newest conversation and message at the top. Older conversations load when scrolling down.

data.name: Sort_Oldest_First_Display_Name
data.value: Oldest first

data.name: Sort_Oldest_First_Description
data.value: Chronological order, oldest at the top. Newer conversations load when scrolling down.

data.name: Show_System_Messages_Display_Name
data.value: Show system messages

data.name: Show_System_Messages_Description
data.value: Include public system messages in the combined timeline.
